- tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh:25-57 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The regression test reads review_autofix.yml directly for dispatch echo callsites that were moved into sourced scripts, so it finds none and fails CI.
  WHY: The test exits with “no AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_SKIPPED echo callsites found”; CI run 37102316779 confirms the failure.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:248 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The inventory lists scripts/smoke_review_dispatch.sh, but that file is absent.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py rejects the unmatched entry, failing CI run 37102316779.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1292 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The PR-named run filter requires `.head_branch == $branch`, dropping workflow_dispatch runs whose `head_branch` is null or empty.
  WHY: The peer check can miss an active run and dispatch a duplicate, while the changes-lost budget can fail to recognize a run and incorrectly block recovery.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1293-1294 | severity=critical | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Exact workflow-path matching does not strip an `@<ref>` suffix, so suffixed paths are excluded from PR-named run results.
  WHY: The peer check can miss an active run and the changes-lost budget can fail to recognize a retry.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1243-1284, 1430 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The peer check calls `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` without a status filter or time cutoff, causing it to page through historical workflow_dispatch runs until the 10-page cap is exhausted.
  WHY: The helper then fails and the peer check fails open with `peer_count=0`, allowing redundant review dispatches; the same query failure can suppress changes-lost recovery.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1238 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: If the repository metadata read for `default_branch` fails, `_autofix_pr_named_review_runs` returns failure.
  WHY: The changes-lost budget caller fails closed and suppresses a legitimate recovery dispatch on a transient API error.
- tests/test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py: entire file (807 lines) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new retrigger-dispatch test module is not wired into CI and is never executed there.
  WHY: Its coverage is not validated during CI runs, so the “Tests cover both” requirement is unmet.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh: Lines 25-57 (assert_review_autofix_dispatch_mirrors function called at line 153) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The function reads .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml directly and searches for echo callsites moved into sourced scripts.
  WHY: It finds 0 callsites, raises SystemExit, and fails the tests-hooks-and-orchestrator CI job; CI run 37102316779 confirms the failure.
- docs/INVENTORY.md: Line 248 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The inventory documents scripts/smoke_review_dispatch.sh, but the file does not exist.
  WHY: tests/inventory_parity.py rejects the unmatched entry and fails CI run 37102316779.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Line 1292 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The filter requires `.head_branch == $branch`, dropping runs with null `head_branch`.
  WHY: The peer check can miss an active run and dispatch a duplicate; the changes-lost budget can miss a run and block automated recovery.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Line 1430 (call site in autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The call omits status and time filters, querying all historical workflow_dispatch runs for both wrappers.
  WHY: The page cap is exhausted, the peer check fails open with `peer_count=0`, and it cannot detect PR-named peer runs.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Lines 1293-1294 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: Exact `.path` comparisons do not strip `@<ref>` suffixes.
  WHY: If GitHub returns suffixed paths in per-wrapper listings, PR-named runs are silently dropped.
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh: Line 1430 (no time/status filter on _autofix_pr_named_review_runs call) | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The peer check fetches all workflow_dispatch runs without status or time filtering, making up to 20 API calls per invocation.
  WHY: Most fetched runs are irrelevant; the peer check only needs queued/in-progress runs from the review-run window.
- Requirement: "Tests cover both [the retrigger dispatch and peer check changes]" (from issue #4898 Expected section)
  Expected change site: tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh lines 25-57 (use expanded_review_autofix_text()), and .github/workflows/ci.yml (wire test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py)
  Evidence of absence: (1) tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh still reads review_autofix.yml directly instead of using expanded_review_autofix_text() to inline the sourced script bodies, so the test contract is broken. (2) tests/test_retrigger_default_branch_dispatch.py (807 new lines of test coverage) was created but never wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml — grep across all workflow YAML files returns zero references.
- Requirement: "review_autofix.yml stays under the CLAUDE.md section 27 guard ... move any body that grows into scripts/review_autofix_step_<slug>.sh" (from issue #4898 Expected section)
  Expected change site: tests/review_autofix_step_scripts.py
  Evidence of absence: The two new step scripts are correctly registered, the workflow correctly sources them, and the workflow file size guard is happy. This requirement IS met.
